title: WizCRM
desc: A landing page and product visuals for WizCommerce’s AI-first CRM.
lead: I designed WizCRM’s landing page and product visuals, connecting its CRM and AI features to everyday sales tasks.
body: I designed the WizCRM landing page and supporting product visuals at WizCommerce. The page connects account information, AI assistance and everyday sales tasks.
detail: The three-day scope covered research, visual direction, page design and supporting visuals while the product interface was still evolving.
captions: Core CRM capabilities — product illustration system
Product-led hero and lavender visual direction
Animated CRM cards — accounts, tasks and pipeline

story.challenge: Explain WizCRM’s core capabilities and AI features in one connected landing page, with three days for research, design and supporting visuals while the interface was still evolving.
decisions: Lead with the product. A focused hero, editorial typography and a consistent lavender palette connect the page.
Build illustrations around everyday tasks: reviewing accounts, creating follow-ups, managing quotes and tracking deals.
Show what AI helps someone do, using specific moments such as prioritising opportunities and creating tasks.
story.result: The finished showcase brings together the landing page, device mockups, feature illustrations and motion studies.

context: WizCommerce · CRM landing page · Three-day design scope
contribution: Researched the product and shaped the landing page’s visual direction.
Designed the page and supporting illustrations around accounts, follow-ups, quotes and deals.
Created motion studies to show product features and interactions.
summary: I designed WizCRM’s landing page and product visuals, connecting its CRM and AI features to everyday sales tasks.
